name.value: The Old Firehouse Wine & Cocktail Bar

description.value: The Old Firehouse Wine & Cocktail Bar is an artisanal wine and cocktail bar opened in March 2012 by the Downie Family, located in Downtown Duncan's City Square in the Cowichan Valley. It serves scratch-made food using fresh, often locally sourced and organic ingredients, alongside an extensive collection of wines, cocktails, whiskies, and creative non-alcoholic drinks. The bar regularly hosts live music, comedy nights, winemaker's dinners, and hands-on cocktail classes, making it a lively cultural anchor in the heart of Duncan.
